genesis-project-workbench.content_prompt: A shared wooden workbench seen from a slightly elevated oblique angle, three separate open shallow project drawers, each retaining a distinct miniature mechanical assembly and a folded note. One selected drawer is gently pulled forward with a small red tab and its matching note tucked securely inside; the other drawers retain their own notes and parts. A single connecting rail organizes the drawers without mixing their contents. Concept metaphor for project-scoped drafts, tabs and work context; not an actual product UI. No human figure, screens, arrows, node graph or text.

genesis-provider-account-setup.content_prompt: A close editorial still life of an open precision instrument case. One distinctive account key rests in a fitted compartment next to three different interchangeable calibrated instrument heads and a small analog schedule dial. A narrow red latch attaches the key compartment to the chosen instrument head; other parts remain neatly separated. Concept metaphor for one authenticated provider account carrying multiple model choices and a shared schedule. No passwords, text, logo, UI cards, locks suggesting guaranteed security, or network diagram. Intimate cropped three-quarter composition, unlike a wide workbench.
